query: I'm 9 weeks pregnant and want to do the abortion with pills at home. What's the latest stage I can take them?
notes: New. Entry: "An EMA is only offered in the community up to 10+0 weeks (≤ 70 days) of pregnancy, so timing matters."

query: I took the abortion pills yesterday and now I have sharp pain low on one side, pain at the tip of my shoulder and I feel dizzy. Can it wait until the clinic opens?
notes: New. Entry: "You have signs of a possible **ectopic pregnancy** (a pregnancy outside the womb): abdominal or pelvic pain, vaginal bleeding, shoulder tip pain, dizziness, or fainting."

query: My 14 year old daughter's teacher thinks she has ADHD. Do the symptoms need to have started when she was little?
notes: New. Entry: "were present before the age of 12 years, and are excessive for the child's developmental level"

query: My 8 year old has ADHD-type behaviour and takes hours to fall asleep even with a good bedtime routine. What might the doctor consider?
notes: New. Entry: "Your doctor may consider melatonin if the child takes a long time to fall asleep despite good sleep habits."

query: What is the paracetamol dose per kg for a child with a painful broken arm?
notes: New. Entry: "15 mg/kg (to a maximum of 1 g per dose) every 4 hours, up to 4 times per day (to a maximum of 60 mg/kg/day)."

query: My child was given strong pain medicine for a fracture and is now very sleepy and breathing slowly. What do I do?
notes: New. Entry: "If a child who has been given an opioid becomes very drowsy or their breathing slows, this can be life-threatening. Call 111 or go to the emergency department."

query: I'm 6 weeks pregnant and I have epilepsy and take anti-seizure medicine. What dose of folic acid should I take?
notes: New. Entry: "**5 mg once daily** if you have:"

query: I have lupus and I'm newly pregnant. What aspirin dose is used to lower pre-eclampsia risk, and when does it start?
notes: New. Entry: "**Low-dose enteric-coated aspirin 100 mg at night** from 12 weeks of pregnancy, and"

query: My GAD-7 score came back as 12. What level of anxiety is that?
notes: New. Entry: "| GAD-7 score | 5 to 9 | 10 to 14 | ≥ 15 |"

query: My anxiety has got so bad that I've started thinking about ending my life and I have a plan. Should I wait for my next appointment?
notes: New. Entry: "- **If you have a plan or feel you might act on it, call 111 or go to the emergency department.** This needs an urgent (acute) mental health assessment."

query: I think I might be autistic as an adult. Can I get a diagnosis through the public system?
notes: New. Entry: "Adult autism assessments are not publicly funded."

query: I'm autistic and my sleep is terrible. Is there a supplement with evidence behind it?
notes: New. Entry: "Existing evidence suggests **melatonin** can be recommended for sleep problems."

query: I had a gastric bypass 3 months ago and now I want to start trying for a baby. How long should I wait?
notes: New. Entry: "Avoid pregnancy for 12 to 18 months after bariatric surgery."

query: My dietitian wants me on a very low calorie diet before my weight loss operation. How many calories a day is that?
notes: New. Entry: "plans a very low calorie diet (700 kcal a day) for at least 2 weeks before surgery"

query: My mum did the Mini-ACE memory test. What score means cognitive impairment is likely?
notes: New. Entry: "A score of 25 or less suggests cognitive impairment is likely."

query: Dad has been getting more confused and his head CT shows bleeding on the brain. The GP says he needs hospital. Can we take him in a day or two?
notes: New. Entry: "A head CT shows a significant abnormality, such as a bleed, a space-occupying lesion (a mass), or hydrocephalus (fluid build-up in the brain). Call 111 or go to the emergency department."

query: I took St John's wort for a month while I have a Jadelle implant and I've now stopped it. How long should I keep using condoms?
notes: New. Entry: "The effect takes 28 days to wear off, even after a single dose."

query: I can't feel one of my implant rods in my arm any more. How do doctors find it?
notes: New. Entry: "For the two-rod levonorgestrel implant, an X-ray of the arm with the insertion site marked can find the rods."

query: I run my contraceptive pill packs together for period pain and keep getting breakthrough bleeding. How long a break from the hormone pills should I take?
notes: New. Entry: "your doctor may suggest a hormone-free break of 4 to 7 days."

query: My period pain is severe and nothing I have tried has worked. How long does the doctor try treatment before referring me to a gynaecologist?
notes: New. Entry: "Your doctor may refer you for a gynaecology assessment if severe symptoms have not responded after at least 3 months of treatment."

query: I'm about to do a stool test for H. pylori and I take omeprazole every day. Do I need to stop it first?
notes: New. Entry: "Your doctor will make sure you have stopped PPI treatment for 2 weeks before testing and have not taken antibiotics within the last month."

query: I've had indigestion for weeks and this morning I vomited blood. Should I book a GP appointment for next week?
notes: New. Entry: "Vomiting blood (haematemesis) or passing black, tarry stools (melaena)"

query: I have food stuck in my throat after eating chicken and I can't even swallow my own saliva. What should I do?
notes: New. Entry: "You cannot swallow your own saliva. This is a total obstruction and needs hospital assessment."

query: Solid food has become hard to swallow but drinks go down fine. What does that usually point to?
notes: New. Entry: "Difficulty with solid food usually points to a structural narrowing (mechanical obstruction)."

query: How often and how much steroid cream should I put on an adult eczema flare?
notes: New. Entry: "**Apply liberally once daily**, enough to see a good shiny layer on the skin."

query: My eczema flared and now I have clusters of small punched-out sores spreading fast, with a fever. Can I wait to see my GP?
notes: New. Entry: "You may have **extensive eczema herpeticum** (eczema-prone skin infected with the herpes simplex virus)."

query: I have epilepsy and had a minor seizure. How long must I stop driving?
notes: New. Entry: "You must stop driving for 12 months after any seizure, minor seizure, or aura."

query: I'm a 25 year old woman with epilepsy and I'm not planning a pregnancy. Should I still take folic acid, and how much?
notes: New. Entry: "Recommend folic acid 5 mg daily, especially if you take sodium valproate, even if you are not planning pregnancy."

query: My dad was diagnosed with stomach cancer at 38. Is that worth raising with my doctor for my own risk?
notes: New. Entry: "You or a first-degree relative with gastric (stomach) cancer diagnosed aged younger than 40 years."

query: What proportion of breast and bowel cancers are caused by an inherited gene mutation?
notes: New. Entry: "Most cancer is not due to an inherited mutation. For example, only 5% of all breast and colon cancer is due to an inherited mutation."

query: I have fibromyalgia and three months of treatment has not helped. What is the next step?
notes: New. Entry: "**Specialised pain service:** severe disability and pain affect your quality of life or work, and/or there is no improvement at 3 months despite the treatment above."

query: My fibromyalgia is mostly tiredness and bad sleep. Which medicine do doctors usually try first?
notes: New. Entry: "| **Fatigue** | Amitriptyline, pregabalin | Venlafaxine, pregabalin | Amitriptyline | Amitriptyline, pregabalin |"

query: My leg hurts constantly even at rest, my toes look dark and I can't find a pulse in my foot. Should I just rest it?
notes: New. Entry: "**Call 111 or go to the emergency department if you may have critical limb ischaemia** (a severe lack of blood supply to a limb)."

query: How old does a wound have to be before it counts as chronic?
notes: New. Entry: "A wound more than 2 weeks old is treated as chronic."

query: My voice goes hoarse on and off and I clear my throat a lot, with reflux symptoms. What might my doctor try?
notes: New. Entry: "**A trial of a proton pump inhibitor (PPI)** such as omeprazole, with or without Gaviscon, for 6 weeks."

query: My voice has been hoarse and now my breathing has become noisy and high-pitched. Should I book an ENT appointment?
notes: New. Entry: "Stridor (noisy, high-pitched breathing)."

query: I had condomless sex 2 days ago with a partner who might have HIV. Is it too late to do anything?
notes: New. Entry: "You may have been exposed to HIV in the last 72 hours. Your doctor may consider urgent post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP)."

query: What dose of doxycycline is used as doxy-PEP after condomless sex?
notes: New. Entry: "A single 200 mg dose of doxycycline taken within 72 hours of condomless sex is shown to significantly reduce the risk of chlamydia and syphilis infection."

query: I have Crohn's disease and now have a fever, a racing heart and bad belly pain. Can I wait for my gastroenterologist appointment next month?
notes: New. Entry: "**Call 111 or go to the emergency department if you have suspected or known IBD and you have:**"

query: When is the first colonoscopy to check for bowel cancer offered after ulcerative colitis starts?
notes: New. Entry: "A baseline colonoscopy is offered at about 10 years after the disease starts."
